messages:
maria: FYI I kicked off a quick sanity bench for lotus-7b on the staging GPU pool — wanted to publish the numbers and get quick eyes. :eyes:
aj: thanks — do you have config and raw logs? can you paste the p50/p95 and tokens/s?
lee: also curious about batch size and whether KV cache was enabled. small changes there usually move p95 a lot.
maria: short config: batch_size=8, max_tokens=512, kv_cache=yes, quant=fp16, tiling=disabled. ran against a cold start and a warmed run. command I used:```bash
./bench_runner --model lotus-7b --devices g4dn-xlarge --batch 8 --tokens 512 --warmup 50 --iters 200 --kv-cache on
```
perf-bot: lotus-7b -> bench artifact uploaded: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/benches/4312345678/lotus7b/ (contains traces + flamegraphs)
sam: quick paste of numbers from the warmed run: p50=95ms, p95=240ms, p99=620ms, mean_tok/s=380, mem=18.2GB GPU. cold start p50~420ms (startup + load).
aj: those p95/p99 spikes at 620ms for p99 — any logs showing evictions or GC?
qa-jen: did you run the regression compare vs our baseline model? baseline (stable-22) numbers for a similar profile were p50=88ms p95=210ms tok/s=400. so lotus is slightly slower but within expected for the architecture difference.
maria: attached a tiny sampling of the logs where a p99 spike happens:
```
[2026-03-15T09:23:11Z] request_id=abc123 seq=340 tok=512 step=112 latency=623ms
[2026-03-15T09:23:11Z] kvcache: miss (prefix len=24)
[2026-03-15T09:23:11Z] rpc: fetch weights from s3 took 180ms
```
lee: that rpc weight fetch is the culprit for cold-starts. but for warmed runs the kvcache miss could mean our prefix hashing didn't line up. can you rerun with prefix_alignment=enabled? small change in tokenizer/prefixing sometimes causes frequent kvcache misses.
maria: re-run queued with prefix_alignment=on, will post results in ~20m.
aj: also try batch_size=4 and batch_size=12 to see how throughput/latency tradeoff looks. include the continuous-batching flag on/off.
sam: FYI I spot-checked the flamegraph — there's a hotspot in attention_kernels (tiling) around long sequence handling. enabling tiling reduced p95 by ~10% in an earlier run for another model. maybe try tiling=enabled as an extra axis.
perf-bot: new artifact (rerun): https://artifacts.redwood.internal/benches/4312345678/lotus7b/rerun1
maria: quick summary from rerun1 (prefix_alignment=on, batch=8, tiling=off): warmed p50=92ms p95=210ms p99=480ms tok/s=395. improvement across the board, p99 reduced a lot.
lee: great — looks like alignment fixed the kvcache churn. can we add a short note to the onboarding doc about tokenizer edgecases and prefix_alignment default?
maria: I updated the model onboarding PR with the bench link and a short note in the README: https://git.internal/redwood/models/lotus7b/pull/42
aj: LGTM, left one comment on the PR about adding the tiling check matrix.
qa-jen: can we tag this thread with the final verdict? probable to promote to canary with default prefix_alignment=on and tiling=disabled, and a follow-up to test tiling in A/B for Dedicated customers. :partyparrot:
maria: agreed. I'll schedule the canary tomorrow morning during the low-traffic window and notify infra. thanks all for the quick reviews.
lee: ping me when canary is up and I'll watch tail-latency.
maria: will do — closing this thread after the canary update. :white_check_mark:
